name: show_workflow
title: Show publishing progress
description: Display authoritative progress for a job returned by Dashless. Preview and Publish open an authenticated browser review; this tool cannot approve publication.

name: request_rollback_approval
title: Review a rollback
description: Open a signed-in review for an exact previous release. Does not approve or perform rollback. Requires the site rollback approval extension.

name: import_chatgpt_file
title: Import an image from ChatGPT
description: Import a user-provided PNG, JPEG, or WebP into an owner-bound upload session (8 MiB maximum). Never accepts local paths or arbitrary web URLs. Requires the site upload extension.
